messages.subject: Uploading data
parts:
Novice Shiny user here (so be gentle - and don't assume that I know much).  I have been successful in creating some useful shiny apps for statistics teaching purposes, but have hit a point where I can't sort out the approach to something simple.  I have worked through the tutorial and the examples within the shiny package so that I know how to:

1.  Use selectInput give the user a choice of data frames internal to R, or made available from files on the shiny server,
and
2.  permit the user to upload data from a csv file  ( I think this was example 09).

But what I need to do is both 1 and 2, where I want the list of data sets shown with the selectInput updated to include both the original data frames from 1, and the new newly uploaded data frame and even multiple uploads (done sequentially).

Would it be possible to include such a capability in the examples and the tutorial?

I assume that the approach might be something like I already use to update variable names when the user chooses different data frames (a uiOutput statement in ui.R)

I have seen examples of this in apps that others have posted here, but those apps are so complex that I can't yet sort through the extensive code to identify the features that do the simpler thing that I describe above.

Thanks in advance, and thanks for all the tips that appear in this group.
You can look at my proof of concept apps that are still under major development here:
http://www.albany.edu/psychology/statistics/#applets
Bruce

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Uploading data
parts:
I used reactive values. Useful if you want users to change the data (e.g., remove variables). In global.R I specify values <- reactiveValues(). The relevant function is listed below. You can see it in action at:

http://vnijs.rady.ucsd.edu:3838/marketing/

loadUserData <- function(filename, uFile) {

  ext <- file_ext(filename)
  objname <- sub(paste(".",ext,sep = ""),"",basename(filename))
  ext <- tolower(ext)

  if(ext == 'rda' || ext == 'rdata') {
    robjname <- load(uFile)
    values[[objname]] <- data.frame(get(robjname))  # only work with data.frames
  }

  if(length(values[['datasetlist']]) == 0 || values[['datasetlist']][1] == '') {
    values[['datasetlist']] <- c(objname)
  } else {
    values[['datasetlist']] <- unique(c(objname,values[['datasetlist']]))
  }

  if(ext == 'sav') {
    values[[objname]] <- as.data.frame(as.data.set(spss.system.file(uFile)))
  } else if(ext == 'dta') {
    values[[objname]] <- read.dta(uFile)
  } else if(ext == 'csv') {
    values[[objname]] <- read.csv(uFile, header=input$header, sep=input$sep)

}
}

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Uploading data
parts:
This is a rather elementary exercise using the available examples. 

Try something like this :

ui.R
fileInput("upload", "Upload a CSV file:"),
selectInput("dataselect", "Select a dataset:", choices=list("data1", "data2"))

server.R
getFile <- reactive({
  if(is.null(input$upload)) return(NULL)
  read.csv(input$upload$datapath)
})
observe({
  if(!is.null(input$upload)) updateSelectInput(session, "dataselect", choices=list("data1", "data2", "mydata"))
})
workdataset <- reactive({
  choice <- input$dataselect
  if(choice=="data1") return(...)
  if(choice=="data2") return(...)
  if(choice=="mydata") return(getFile())
})
